newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CATT IN LINE FOR ENGLAND RECALL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CATT IN LINE FOR ENGLAND RECALL.

text.p: Mike Catt looks set to return at fly-half for England if Paul Grayson fails to recover from a leg injury in time to face Wales in their final Five Nations championship match on March 15.

Following the late surge which saw France snatch a 23-20 win at Twickenham last Saturday, England also left open other options for change for the match at Cardiff Arms Park by selecting a 27-man squad on Thursday.
Grayson is doubtful after picking up a muscle problem during a club game on Tuesday.
The highly rated Will Greenwood is also included in the squad as coach Jack Rowell looks at possible changes in the centre and winger Adedayo Adebayo is also recalled.
Neil Back and Tony Diprose were selected, adding some pressure to the incumbent back-row trio of Richard Hill, Tim Rodber and Lawrence Dallaglio.

The England squad is: Backs: Tim Stimpson, Jon Sleightholme, Will Carling, Phil de Glanville, Tony Underwood, Paul Grayson, Andy Gomarsall, Will Greenwood, Adedayo Adebayo, Mike Catt, Jeremy Guscott, Austin Healey; Forwards: Graham Rowntree, Mark Regan, Jason Leonard, Martin Johnson, Simon Shaw, Lawrence Dallaglio, Richard Hill, Tim Rodber, John Mallett, Garath Archer, Ben Clarke, Phil Greening, Darren Garforth, Neil Back, Tony Diprose.
